zh: 每一步之后都要把生命值截断到 [0,100]，截断会丢掉超出的部分，所以结果和变化的顺序有关，不能先把所有变化加起来再截断。
直接按顺序模拟：每次先加上变化量，再截断到 0 到 100 之间。
读入 n 和初始值 health；对每个变化量 c，令 health 等于 max(0, min(100, health+c))；处理完所有变化后输出 health，n 为 0 时就输出初始值。
en: After every step the health is clamped to [0, 100], and clamping throws away the excess, so the result depends on the order of changes. You cannot sum all the changes first and clamp once.
Simulate in order: add each change, then clamp the result to the range 0..100.
Read n and the initial health. For each change c, set health = max(0, min(100, health + c)). After all changes, print health; when n is 0 this is just the initial value.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Simulate in order, adding first and then clamping at each step.

## Correctness

By induction, every update is exactly what the statement describes; the changes cannot be summed first, because intermediate clamping discards the overflowing part.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(1) apart from the input.
